description: This file defines a class RepairAndClear that provides various methods for repairing, clearing cache, rebuilding extensions, and managing database and module configurations in a SuiteCRM/SugarCRM environment. The class includes methods for cache clearing, database repairs, extension rebuilding, audit table rebuilds, and related maintenance tasks.

classes.name: RepairAndClear
classes.description: A utility class for executing maintenance operations such as repairs, cache clears, and extension rebuilds in a SuiteCRM/SugarCRM environment.

methods.name: repairAndClearAll
methods.description: Performs a series of repair and cache-clearing operations based on selected actions and modules.

methods.name: repairDatabase
methods.description: Includes external script to repair database tables.

methods.name: repairDatabaseSelectModules
methods.description: Repairs database tables for selected modules, involving output or export of SQL statements.

methods.name: rebuildExtensions
methods.description: Rebuilds module extensions and outputs status messages.

methods.name: clearSmarty
methods.description: Clears Smarty template cache files.

methods.name: clearXMLfiles
methods.description: Clears cached XML files.

methods.name: clearDashlets
methods.description: Clears cached dashlet files.

methods.name: clearThemeCache
methods.description: Clears the theme cache.

methods.name: clearSugarFeedCache
methods.description: Flushes backend cache for SugarFeed.

methods.name: clearTpls
methods.description: Clears template cache for modules and inline editing.

methods.name: clearVardefs
methods.description: Clears cached vardefs for modules.

methods.name: clearJsFiles
methods.description: Clears cached JavaScript files for modules.

methods.name: clearJsLangFiles
methods.description: Clears cached JavaScript language files for modules.

methods.name: clearLanguageCache
methods.description: Clears language cache files for all or selected modules.

methods.name: clearSearchCache
methods.description: Removes the cached unified search modules file.

methods.name: clearExternalAPICache
methods.description: Clears external API cache via ExternalAPIFactory.

methods.name: rebuildAuditTables
methods.description: Recreates audit tables for modules with audit enabled.

methods.name: _rebuildAuditTablesHelper
methods.description: Helper to rebuild individual audit tables for a given bean.

methods.name: _clearCache
methods.description: Recursively deletes cache files with specified extension in a directory.

methods.name: _getModuleNamePlural
methods.description: Gets the plural name of a module given its singular name from the bean list.
